asset_set: Questionnaire Q5 option 1 — Writing fantasy novel chapters

art_style.reference: Match src/assets/1.1.png and 1.2.png — unDraw-style full-body edu characters
art_style.fill: solid flat color blocks with minimal cel shade
art_style.mood: cozy imaginative-writer energy — approachable storytelling hobby, not a formal publishing office

riasec_accent.use: dragon figurine scale highlights, cardigan button trim

riasec_secondary.use: ink bottle glass tint, hair ribbon

color.background: transparent — faint grey decorative circles allowed at 15% opacity

character.face: minimal — two dot eyes, dreamy smile, no detailed nose
character.diversity_note: unique cast per slot — distinct hair color and style, skin tone, and outfit from prior slots

pose.stance: full body, standing beside a small standing writing lectern or podium prop, one leg slightly forward
pose.action: holding an open notebook in one arm while writing a fresh line with a fountain pen, a small dragon figurine perched on the lectern edge
pose.facing: 3/4 toward lectern, gaze down at page

top.garment: cozy cardigan over a simple dress
top.detail: charcoal dress underlayer, gold button trim

subject.scene_narrative: A dreamy young woman stands beside a small writing lectern, an open notebook cradled in one arm as she writes a fresh line with a fountain pen, a tiny gold dragon figurine perched at the lectern edge — a full-body flat vector figure capturing the cozy magic of building an imaginary world one chapter at a time.
subject.hero_prop: open notebook with wavy scribble handwriting lines, no readable words
supporting_props: small gold dragon figurine with tiny wings
loose feather quill resting on the lectern
subject.environment: thin grey floor line only, two faint grey decorative circles behind figure — no bookshelf interior

composition.layout: figure right-of-center, lectern with notebook left, balanced like 1.1.png
composition.thumbnail_test: silhouette of person + notebook and dragon readable at 160px

generation.negative_prompt: face photograph, realistic skin pores, text, watermark, letter A, readable words, sentences, border frame, sticker card, top-down POV hands only, white background fill, photorealistic, 3d render, cropped head, extra limbs, scary dragon

prompt_for_image_ai: Flat vector full-body illustration, 640x640, transparent PNG background. Style MUST match KursoKo reference assets 1.1.png and 1.2.png: unDraw-inspired edu character, thin 2px dark outline #2D2D2D, flat color fills, minimal dot-eye face. Dreamy college-age young woman, fair rosy skin, long wavy auburn hair, purple #4B2C7F cozy cardigan with gold #FFD54F button trim over a charcoal dress reaching mid-calf, flats. She stands beside a small writing lectern, an open cream notebook cradled in one arm showing wavy scribble handwriting lines, writing a fresh line with a light-grey fountain pen with a gold nib band; a tiny gold dragon figurine with small wings perches at the lectern edge beside a lavender-tinted glass ink bottle and a loose tan feather quill. Thin grey floor line, faint grey decorative circles only — NO opaque background, NO text, NO letter, NO border frame, NO readable words. Subtle Artistic RIASEC gold accent on the dragon and cardigan trim. Cozy imaginative energy, full head-to-feet visible.
